query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `dailyFinancialSummary` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`summaryDate` timestamp NOT NULL,
	`totalRevenue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	`packageRevenue` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`fullPackageRevenue` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`serviceRevenue` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`otherRevenue` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalExpenses` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	`shippingExpenses` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`purchaseExpenses` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`operationalExpenses` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`otherExpenses` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`grossProfit` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`netProfit` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`cashIn` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`cashOut` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`netCashFlow` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`packagesDelivered` int DEFAULT 0,
	`fullPackagesSold` int DEFAULT 0,
	`invoicesIssued` int DEFAULT 0,
	`paymentsReceived` int DEFAULT 0,
	`totalReceivables` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`totalPayables` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`isFinalized` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	`finalizedAt` timestamp NULL,
	`finalizedById` int,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `dailyFinancialSummary_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `dailyFinancialSummary_summaryDate_unique` UNIQUE(`summaryDate`)
);
